notes.title: Develop another game
notes.notes: I must tell you, that I need to create much more easy game, than The Message. Without money I can't develop this in future, so don't wait for updates in next 3 months.

notes.title: V. 0.023 patch
notes.notes:
Edited/New:
[list]
[*] the cursor is visible in the main menu, it is more convenient to navigate with it
[*] fixed a bug due to HUD did not appear at the beginning of the level
[*] added animation of throwing a bat, there may be bugs
[*] restart is done, but it is also not checked
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.023 release
notes.notes:
Update/Edited:
[list]
[*] a new model of enemies with dismemberment, physical clothes and voluminous hair
[*] worked on animations. Now the legs adjust to the surface on which the character is standing (works only when he is standing still. Hasn't done this for running yet). In the next. updates I will finish what I wrote about in previous posts (turn of the head, eyes; physical animations)
[*] melee is done
[*] redesigned main menu
[*] the pause menu can be removed in 2 ways: by pressing the Continue button or by pressing the pause button on the keyboard
[*] Added Anti-Aliasing setting to graphics settings
[*] added bloody footprints
[*] updated intelligence of bots
[*] many bugs fixed (and added...)
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.23 beta release
notes.notes: The update is quite large, because of this a lot of bugs. In the future, a full update will be released, which will fix the errors of this update. When it is released, I will write what is new in game.
